name: web-orlina-visual-ux-strategy-folders-type-colour-photography
title: Orlina visual UX strategy as folder-tab panels: editorial+commerce, type and colour, photography
whatItIs: A dark page with a gold silk ribbon and 'Visual UX Strategy 05', then three folder-tab panels: 'Editorial + Commerce' with a homepage screenshot and circular text badge, 'Typography & Color' with sans and italic serif 'Aa' specimens and brown, black, grey and purple swatches, and 'Photography' with a grid of denim shoots.
whatItMeans: Organised and tactile; folder tabs make a style guide feel like a designer's archive.
techniques: Frame each guide section as a folder with a tab.
Pair two typefaces as big 'Aa' specimens.
Show photography direction as a grid of real shots.

vocabulary.definition: A sample showing a typeface's characters.
A sample block of a colour.
